note: roles is the cyberpunk mode (tone must match colors.json). openRoles is the Any Warpaints mode (kinds lists which paint kinds can fill the slot).

roles.label: Facade
roles.usage: Main walls and large panels. Basecoat the whole building in this, it carries most of the surface area.

roles.label: Structure
roles.usage: Girders, ductwork, window frames, recessed panels and roof clutter. A step lighter or darker than the facade so the shapes read.

roles.label: Hardware
roles.usage: Pipes, railings, AC units, antennas, hazard markings and weathering. Small areas, drybrush or edge highlight.

roles.label: Primary neon
roles.usage: Main signage, holo-ads and the strongest light source. Paint over a white or very light basecoat, then glaze the glow onto nearby surfaces.

roles.label: Secondary neon
roles.usage: Lit windows, edge strips, door lights and reflected glow on wet streets. Supports the primary, use it in more places but smaller.

openRoles.label: Base
openRoles.usage: Main colour over most of the model or terrain piece. Basecoat everything that will end up this colour.

openRoles.label: Shade
openRoles.usage: Darker partner of the base. Recesses, folds and deep shadow, layered or glazed into the base.

openRoles.label: Highlight
openRoles.usage: Lighter partner of the base. Raised areas and edge highlights, keep it to the top surfaces.

openRoles.label: Secondary
openRoles.usage: Second largest area: cloth, trim panels, straps, foliage or a contrasting armour section.

openRoles.label: Accent
openRoles.usage: Small spot colour that draws the eye: gems, lenses, insignia, metal fittings or an effect.
